title: Ceiling suspended packaged HVAC units with compressors.
officialText: Equipment such as heat pumps, AC units, or similar equipment, that is suspended from a structure shall be resiliently supported from or on the building structure. Vibration isolators shall have a minimum isolation efficiency of 90 percent at the lowest disturbing frequency.
